mapper.sql: id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_type, path, route_name, component, icon, permission_code, sort_no, visible, status, remark, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_menu ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT FROM sys_menu ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM sys_menu WHERE status = 1 AND visible = 1 ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu (parent_id, menu_name, menu_type, path, route_name, component, icon, permission_code, sort_no, visible, status, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{menuName}, #{menuType}, #{path}, #{routeName}, #{component}, #{icon}, #{permissionCode}, #{sortNo}, #{visible}, #{status}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_menu SET parent_id = #{parentId}, menu_name = #{menuName}, menu_type = #{menuType}, path = #{path}, route_name = #{routeName}, component = #{component}, icon = #{icon}, permission_code = #{permissionCode}, sort_no = #{sortNo}, visible = #{visible}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
